A few agencies appear to offer **generative engine optimization (GEO)** alongside **traditional technical SEO** for small businesses, including **Revisible**, **Sparkplug Marketing**, and **SEO Discovery**.[7][10][15]

- **Revisible** says it is a managed service built specifically for small business owners and offers GEO for AI tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.[7]
- **Sparkplug Marketing** describes a complete AI search optimization program for small businesses, from **technical schema markup** to content strategy.[10]
- **SEO Discovery** says its services include **technical SEO**, schema markup, AI-friendly content optimization, and ongoing optimization for both traditional and AI-powered search, and it explicitly includes local businesses among its audience.[15]
- **Epic Web Studios** also mentions **structured data and technical SEO** as part of its GEO service.[8]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best fit for your small business type** — for example, local services, ecommerce, or B2B.
